4. Add your JS logic inside the init() function 5. Use window.mBTBridge.send() for shell communication (never use window.parent — blocked by CORS on file://) AVAILABLE GLOBALS (after script tags below load): window.mBT.storage — IndexedDB engine (async) window.mBTLE — Logic engine / calculations window.mBTEmbedded — true when loaded in shell iframe window.mBTBridge — { send(action, payload), openTool(url), notify(message) } SHELL COMMUNICATION EXAMPLES: window.mBTBridge.notify('Saved!'); window.mBTBridge.openTool('../db/index.html'); window.mBTBridge.send('refresh', { store: 'mbt_projects' }); STORAGE EXAMPLES: const projects = await window.mBT.storage.getAllProjects(); await window.mBT.storage.saveProject(obj); EMBEDDED CSS: body.embedded .max-w-4xl → max-width: 100% body.embedded .p-6 → padding: 12px body.embedded h1 → font-size: 1.1rem ============================================================ --> mBT — My Tool
